facts.fact: Mastercard Foundation / AfricaGrow (Allianz-Bertelsmann, Germany) committed an estimated US$5 million as a limited partner to Knife Capital's Knife Fund III, a US$50 million South Africa-based Series A/B technology fund, with US$45 million co-financed by IFC, SA SME Fund, Standard Bank, Skybound Capital and Fireball Capital (no amounts given per co-financier).
